sections.normalized_html:
The probability of an event is the number of favorable outcomes divided by the number of total possible outcomes.

We are told that the jar contains [MATH: 25] balls numbered from [MATH: 1] to [MATH: 25.] So, there is only one ball numbered [MATH: 18.]
